ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Process Injection Via Msra.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential process injection via Microsoft Remote Asssistance (Msra.exe) by looking at suspicious child processes spawned from the aforementioned process. It has been a target used by many threat actors and used for discovery and persistence tactics

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msra\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX("msra\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\arp\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\netstat\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nslookup\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\route\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$")))
